name: poly_no_consecutive_powerful
statement: {k : Type*} [Field k] [DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (f : Polynomial k) (hf : ∀ p : Polynomial k, Irreducible p → p ∣ f → p ^ 2 ∣ f) (hf1 : ∀ p : Polynomial k, Irreducible p → p ∣ f + 1 → p ^ 2 ∣ f + 1) : f.natDegree = 0
closed: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] [DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (f : Polynomial k) (hf : ∀ p : Polynomial k, Irreducible p → p ∣ f → p ^ 2 ∣ f) (hf1 : ∀ p : Polynomial k, Irreducible p → p ∣ f + 1 → p ^ 2 ∣ f + 1), f.natDegree = 0
informal: In char 0 there are no non-constant 'consecutive powerful polynomials': if every irreducible factor of f and of f+1 occurs at least squared then f is constant — a powerful polynomial g satisfies 2·deg rad g ≤ deg g; Uses Mathlib2.ms_mason_stothers_v2 with (f, 1, -(f+1)): deg f < deg rad(f(f+1)) = deg rad f + deg rad(f+1) ≤ deg f/2 + deg f/2, contradiction.
type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (f : Polynomial k), (∀ (p : Polynomial k), Irreducible p → p ∣ f → p ^ 2 ∣ f) → (∀ (p : Polynomial k), Irreducible p → p ∣ f + 1 → p ^ 2 ∣ f + 1) → f.natDegree = 0
